g.text: ABR1 has two routes to reach 10.0.0.0/24:- O (intra-area) with total cost 10.- O IA (inter-area) with total cost 2.The SPF algorithm always chooses intra-area routes (O) over inter-area ones (O IA), regardless of total cost.
